title: Sidewalks at a wall: at which level the walkway meets it

options: IPR's level: the walkway runs on at the blue pin's height up to the wall
the survey's level: the walkway meets the wall at the white pin's height
no walkway along the wall here (a bed, a fence, a building's face)
findings.info: A sidewalk's edge along a survey paved strip drawn as a wall's face for 54 m, where every height the survey has here lies over IPR's walkway. At the white pin the survey has the edge at 241.62 m and no point of the wall's outline within 1 m; IPR's lidar reads 235.67 m 1.5 m in on the sidewalk's side (the blue pin). The street surface holds the edge at 241.62 m, the nearest of the survey's, so the walkway rises 5.9 m in its last 1.5 m to the wall (area 5222 of line 37 in this build). At which level does the walkway meet the wall here? The orange pins are the stretch's ends.
